messages:
maya: FYI planning a short canary tomorrow for the APAC->US fallback routing + stickiness change. want to make this low-risk and get a quick ops ✅. will outline scope + guardrails here. cc @jonah @zara
jonah: thanks — what's the canary percent and which requests are in-scope?
zara: also please note latency SLO and the sticky cookie ttl we use today. we should avoid changing both at once.
maya: canary = 5% of APAC traffic (by region header). scope: only non-authenticated read requests and seq_len >= 128 tokens. stickiness remains enabled but TTL reduced to 24h for the canary. latency SLO unchanged (p50 < 120ms, p95 < 700ms). fallback model = redwood-medium-quantized-v2 (fallback to US region then model variant).
leo: do we gate on model compatibility? some older models don't have kv-cache optimizations, might spike CPU.
maya: good call — added model whitelist and a fallback to a CPU-safe variant. config snippet below (will push to feature-flag service):
```json
{
  "flag": "routing.fallback_apac_to_us",
  "enabled": true,
  "scope": {"region": "apac"},
  "audience": {"percent": 5},
  "filters": {"request_type": "read", "min_tokens": 128},
  "stickiness": {"enabled": true, "ttl": "24h"},
  "fallback_order": ["region:us-west-2","model:redwood-medium-quantized-v2","model:redwood-medium-cpu-safe"],
  "guardrails": {"error_rate_threshold": "5%/5m", "latency_threshold": "700ms", "circuit_breaker": true}
}
```
jonah: can we add a telemetry tag so we can slice metrics? e.g. rollout_tag: "apac-fb-2026-03-canary1"
maya: yep will add rollout_tag and a dedicated prometheus label. also adding an eval prompt set to watch for quality regressions (cc @zara for prompts). PR is up: https://git.internal/redwood/infra/+/blob/feat/apac-fallback-canary (please review)
zara: reviewing now. oncall — @zara will be primary at rollout window. any reason to schedule outside business hours?
maya: aiming for 09:30 PDT tomorrow to align with APAC morning traffic and have SRE overlap. rollout plan: (1) enable audience=1% - smoke, (2) if stable 30m -> 5%, (3) monitor 2h, then either ramp or rollback. rollback command is: `ffctl set routing.fallback_apac_to_us.enabled=false --tag apac-fb-2026-03-canary1`
sre-bot: scheduled alert: canary-window for routing.fallback_apac_to_us at 2026-03-18T16:30:00Z. oncall: @zara. monitors: apac_p95_latency, apac_error_rate, model_quality_alerts.
leo: I'll keep an eye on GPU utilization, will add a short dashboard tile for the canary cohort.
jonah: quick CR ping done, left one comment about the whitelist tests. :thumbsup:
maya: thanks all — will merge after comments cleared and post final rollout timestamp. please ack if you want a manual hold before 5% ramp.
zara: ack — will hold if apac_p95 > 700ms or error_rate > 3% for 15m.
leo: ack.
jonah: ack.
maya: :rocket:
